Problem Description
: This all comes from the backend and limits the station software-wise. The Siemens charging station is not the problem here.
I've now deleted the profile from the charger and restarted it.
After that, I'll check whether the Smart Charging profile is set again by the backend.
If this is the case, you'll have to deal with the backend. Optionally, I can offer to deactivate the backend connection in this case, so that charging can at least take place, but without the option to bill.
For future reference, your case number is
0420517

We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
